subject.title: [Feature]: Mobile apps: per-gateway custom headers for gateways behind authenticating proxies

question: Should mobile support arbitrary per-gateway custom headers for proxy authentication, or should the first supported contract be narrower typed proxy-auth credentials?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but maintainers need to choose the permanent credential boundary for pre-Gateway authentication headers, secure storage, diagnostics redaction, forbidden headers, and platform parity.

options.title: Approve arbitrary per-gateway headers
options.body: Allow general header name/value pairs per gateway if owner/security review accepts the sanitizer, secure-store, redaction, and destination-isolation contract.

options.title: Narrow to typed proxy auth
options.body: Limit the first mobile implementation to typed Basic/Bearer or service-token fields to reduce UX and credential-handling risk.

options.title: Defer native proxy credentials
options.body: Keep mobile proxy-header injection unsupported for now and document VPN, Tailscale, or direct trusted-proxy alternatives while design remains unsettled.

recommendation.title: Approve arbitrary per-gateway headers
recommendation.body: Allow general header name/value pairs per gateway if owner/security review accepts the sanitizer, secure-store, redaction, and destination-isolation contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened this issue, opened the current iOS and Android implementation PRs, and has recent mobile gateway/security-adjacent history.
